mechanism: Tick rule bt∈{+1,−1}; accumulate θ=Σ bt·metric (tick/volume/dollar); close when |θ|≥E[T]·|E[imb/tick]| with O(1) EWM updates of expected bar length and absolute imbalance after each close; EWM span sets how fast threshold tracks regime shifts.

mechanism: Split signed metric into θ+ (buy-side) and θ− (sell-side); close when max(θ+,θ−)≥E[T]·max(E[θ+/T],E[θ−/T]) with dual EWM seeds; unlike imbalance, opposing flow does not cancel the dominant accumulator—sensitive to one-sided bursts and choppy two-sided tape.
data_needed: Tick-rule signed metric (tick/volume/dollar); exp_ticks_init; exp_runs_buy_init and exp_runs_sell_init (or symmetric exp_imbalance_init); ewm_span; tick-rule prev_price/prev_sign persistence.
